title: Metastatic pancreatic cancer, discharged home with hospice, summary + nursing complete

rationale.pac_list: Hospice is not a home health, SNF, IRF or LTCH referral, so the three post-acute choice rules do not apply.
rationale.goals_of_care: DNR/DNI, POLST comfort measures and the patient's stated goals are documented.
rationale.meds_consistent: Both documents list the same six medications; the nursing 'Stop taking' line names only drugs the summary also stops.
